title: Evaporators & Crystallizers
summary: Custom industrial evaporators and crystallizers for liquid concentration, thermal separation and crystal or slurry handling, based on project-specific process data.
body:
Tongyang supports the fabrication of industrial evaporators, crystallization vessels and associated process equipment for liquid concentration and selected solid-liquid processing duties. Equipment selection and configuration depend on feed composition, heat sensitivity, viscosity, fouling tendency, product targets and available utilities.

Types of equipment and process duties

  • Industrial evaporators: concentration of chemical and industrial liquid streams
  • Multi-effect evaporation systems: configurations evaluated against capacity, energy use and process requirements
  • Crystallizers: equipment for specified crystal formation and crystal-slurry handling duties
  • Vapor-liquid separation equipment: vapor separators and related vessels within the agreed process scope
  • Thermal process packages: evaporator bodies, heat-transfer sections, vessels and auxiliaries as specified

Industries and applications

  • Chemical and specialty chemical production
  • Industrial liquid concentration and recovery
  • Salt and inorganic chemical crystallization, subject to process feasibility
  • Product recovery and selected solid-liquid processing duties
  • Thermal processing where feed properties and utility conditions support the proposed configuration

Key technical parameters for quotation

  • Feed characteristics: composition, throughput, inlet temperature, viscosity, solids content and fouling tendency
  • Product targets: final concentration, evaporation rate, crystal-size target, recovery rate and product quality
  • Operating conditions: batch or continuous operation, pressure or vacuum, allowable product temperature and residence time
  • Utilities: steam or heating medium, cooling water, available power and utility conditions
  • Equipment design: materials, corrosion or erosion allowance, circulation or agitation, cleaning method and discharge arrangement
  • Project data: available PFD/P&ID, mass balance, site constraints, controls, inspection and documentation requirements

Process engineering and manufacturing basis

Depending on the agreed scope, equipment may include evaporator bodies, heat-transfer sections, vapor separators, crystallization vessels and mechanical auxiliaries. Pressure-containing parts are reviewed against the specified design code. Process configuration, mass and energy balance, and product-performance expectations require adequate process data and a clearly defined engineering responsibility.

For heat-sensitive, high-viscosity, strongly fouling or difficult crystallization services, feed testing or pilot trials may be necessary before finalizing the equipment configuration and performance basis.

Related equipment

Evaporation and crystallization systems often require heat-transfer and vapor-condensation equipment. Explore our industrial heat exchangers, condensers and coolers for related equipment options. The final selection depends on the process design and utility conditions.

Preparing an evaporator or crystallizer RFQ

For an initial review, provide feed and product specifications, required throughput, target concentration or recovery, operating pressure and temperature, available utilities, and any existing process flow diagram. Identify any known fouling, scaling, heat-sensitivity or crystal-handling challenges.

Quotation basis: final process configuration, equipment dimensions, performance guarantees, testing, certification and supply scope are subject to review of the available process data and project specification.
